title: Samir and the rising rents
topic: In a factory town wages stand still while rents rise: Samir's wage stays flat, his landlord raises the rent, the union holds a meeting, the owner refuses a raise, the workers vote for a protest

notes: Formulation A, domain economy (ChronoCulture weak domain: inequality). Ten meaning units: Samir works at the textile factory / his wage stays flat / the landlord raises the rent / the rent swallows half his pay / colleagues complain at the gate / the union holds a meeting / Samir describes the rising rents / the factory owner refuses a raise / the workers vote for a protest / the whole town discusses the dispute. Subjects alternate between the protagonist (Samir), other people (landlord, colleagues, factory owner, workers), institutions (the union, the whole town) and abstract objects (his wage, the rent), singular and plural. No separable German verbs ('abhalten', 'ablehnen', 'einladen' avoided: 'veranstaltet', 'verweigert'). 'Samir' is the only proper name (genitive 'Samirs' in unit 4). Present tense and positive polarity throughout; unit 9 reads naturally in German, units 1 and 10 in English.
